name: Halland Wool Coat
description: A long, unstructured coat cut from undyed Gotland wool. Softly tailored shoulders, patch pockets, and a belt you can leave undone. Made to be worn for a decade.

name: Torv Quilted Jacket
description: A light quilted layer in a dry taupe. Onion-quilt stitching, snap closure, and enough room for a knit underneath. The piece for the months that cannot decide.

name: Kust Waxed Field Jacket
description: A weather-resistant field jacket in heavy dark olive waxed cotton. Stand collar with storm flap, bellows pockets, and a soft flannel lining. Built to withstand coastal autumn winds.
details: 100% heavy organic cotton with paraffin wax

name: Skog Wool Shearling Jacket
description: A relaxed overshirt jacket cut from dense oat wool twill with a plush natural lamb shearling collar. Double chest pockets, horn buttons, and an unlined easy fit for layering.

name: Vide Merino Crewneck
description: A relaxed crewneck in extra-fine merino, knitted to a mid-gauge so it holds its shape. Ribbed raglan seams, dropped shoulder, oatmeal throughout.

name: Bris Alpaca Cardigan
description: Brushed alpaca with a faint halo, finished with corozo buttons. Deep V, easy body, sleeves long enough to push up.

name: Sund Ribbed Turtleneck
description: A close ribbed turtleneck in charcoal. It sits under everything else in the collection without adding bulk.

name: Lin Oversized Shirt
description: Washed European linen, cut long and wide with a single chest pocket. It creases. That is the point.

name: Grå Poplin Shirt
description: Crisp organic poplin in a pale grey, with a soft collar and a straight hem you can wear out.

name: Sten Cotton Tee
description: A heavyweight ecru tee at 240gsm, boxy through the body with a ribbed neck that stays flat.

name: Falk Wide-Leg Trouser
description: Double-pleated and full through the leg, in a dry sand twill that drapes rather than flares.

name: Ebb Tapered Wool Trouser
description: A quiet flannel trouser with a pressed crease and a clean taper to the ankle. Weight enough for winter.

name: Visby Raw-Edge Wool Scarf
description: An oversized raw-edge fringed scarf woven from thick oatmeal Gotland wool. Unbrushed natural texture that softens with wear.

name: Fårö Heavy Cashmere Crewneck
description: A heavy 4-ply charcoal Mongolian cashmere sweater with chunky 2x2 ribbed collar and cuffs. Exceptionally soft and warm.
details: Dry clean or hand wash cold
